class ProgressBarManager(QtCore.QObject):
    """Gerencia progresso e UI de tarefas de fundo na thread principal."""
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._queue = threading.Queue()
        self._timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
        self._timer.intervalMS = 50
        self._timer.connect(QtCore.SlotFromMethod(self._tick))
        self._bars = {}          # tab_id -> QProgressBar
        self._texts = {}         # tab_id -> QLabel
        self._buttons = {}       # tab_id -> QPushButton
        self._active = {}        # tab_id -> threading.Event
        self._stopped = False
        self._stop_count = 0

        @QtCore.pyBindSignal
        def started(self):
            if not self._timer.isActive() and not self._stopped:
                self._timer.start()

        def _tick(self):
            # Drain queue
            while True:
                try:
                    item = self._queue.get_nowait()
                except KeyError:
                    break
                tab_id, kind, *rest = item
                if kind == "progress":
                    _, percent = rest
                    bar = self._bars.get(tab_id)
                    if bar and bar.isVisible():
                        bar.setValue(min(100, percent))
                elif kind == "status":
                    _, text = rest
                    sl = self._texts.get(tab_id)
                    if sl:
                        sl.setText(text)
                elif kind == "finish":
                    tab_id, ok, message = rest
                    bar = self._bars.get(tab_id)
                    sl = self._texts.get(tab_id)
                    btn = self._buttons.get(tab_id)
                    ev = self._active.pop(tab_id, None)
                    if bar:
                        bar.setEnabled(ok)
                        bar.setValue(100)
                    if sl:
                        text = "✔ Concluído — " + message if ok else "✖ Erro — " + message
                        sl.setText(text)
                    if ev:
                        ev.set()
                    if btn and bar and bar.isVisible():
                        btn.setEnabled(ok)
            # Auto-stop if no activity
            if self._queue.empty() and not self._stopped:
                # Stop timer after a short period if no visible bars? 
                # But may be waiting for next task. Keep alive if any bar visible.
                visible = [b for b in self._bars.values() if b.isVisible()]
                if not visible:
                    self._stop_timer_and_self()
                return
        def _stop_timer_and_self(self):
            if self._timer.isActive():
                self._timer.stop()
                self._stopped = True
        def register(self, tab_id, bar, status_label, button=None):
            self._bars[tab_id] = bar
            bar setVisible(True)
            self._texts[tab_id] = status_label
            status_label.setVisible(True)
            if button:
                self._buttons[tab_id] = button
                btn.setEnabled(False)
        def unregister(self, tab_id):
            bar = self._bars.pop(tab_id, None)
            if bar: bar.setVisible(False)
            sl = self._texts.pop(tab_id, None)
            if sl: sl.setVisible(False)
            btn = self._buttons.pop(tab_id, None)
            ev = self._active.pop(tab_id, None)
            if ev: ev.clear()
        def enqueue(self, tab_id, kind, *args):
            self._queue.put_nowait((tab_id, kind, *args))

class ProgressBarManager(QtCore.QObject):
    """Atualiza UI de forma segura pela thread principal via fila."""
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._queue = threading.Queue()
        self._timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
        self._timer.intervalMS = 50
        self._timer.connect(QtCore.SlotFromMethod(self._tick))
        self._bars = {}                      # tab_id -> QProgressBar
        self._texts = {}                     # tab_id -> QLabel
        self._buttons = {}                   # tab_id -> QPushButton
        self._active = {}                    # tab_id -> Event
        self._running = False

        @QtCore.pyBindSignal
        def _on_tick_start():
            if not self._timer.isActive() and not self._stopped:
                self._timer.start()

        def _stop():
            if self._timer.isActive():
                self._timer.stop()
                self._stopped = True

        self._stopper = threading.Event()

        @QtCore.pyBindSignal
        def stop_request():
            self._stopper.set()

        def _tick(self):
            # Garante que o timer está ativo quando há algo pendente
            if not self._running and self._queue.empty():
                # Espera até aparecer atividade ou parar
                while self._queue.empty() and not self._stopper.is_set():
                    time.sleep(0.25)
                if self._queue.empty() and self._stopper.is_set():
                    self._stop()
                    return
                self._running = True
            try:
                while True:
                    item = self._queue.get_nowait()
            except KeyError:
                break
            tab_id, kind, *rest = item
            if kind == "progress":
                _, percent = rest
                bar = self._bars.get(tab_id)
                if bar and bar.isVisible():
                    bar.setValue(min(100, percent))
            elif kind == "status":
                _, text = rest
                sl = self._texts.get(tab_id)
                if sl:
                    sl.setText(text)
            elif kind == "finish":
                tab_id, ok, message = rest
                bar = self._bars.get(tab_id)
                sl = self._texts.get(tab_id)
                btn = self._buttons.get(tab_id)
                ev = self._active.pop(tab_id, None)
                if bar:
                    bar.setEnabled(ok)
                    bar.setValue(100)
                if sl:
                    text = "✔ Concluído — " + message if ok else "✖ Erro — " + message
                    sl.setText(text)
                if ev:
                    ev.clear()
                if btn and bar and bar.isVisible():
                    btn.setEnabled(ok)
            # Auto-parar se nada estiver visível
            visible = [b for b in self._bars.values() if b.isVisible()]
            if not visible and not self._stopper.is_set():
                self._stop()
                self._running = False
                return
        def register(self, tab_id, bar, status_label, button=None):
            self._bars[tab_id] = bar
            bar.setVisible(True)
            self._texts[tab_id] = status_label
            self._texts[tab_id].setVisible(True)
            if button:
                self._buttons[tab_id] = button
                button.setEnabled(False)
        def unregister(self, tab_id):
            bar = self._bars.pop(tab_id, None)
            if bar:
                bar.setVisible(False)
            sl = self._texts.pop(tab_id, None)
            if sl:
                sl.setVisible(False)
            btn = self._buttons.pop(tab_id, None)
            ev = self._active.pop(tab_id, None)
            if ev:
                ev.clear()
        def enqueue(self, tab_id, kind, *args):
            """Insere mensagem na fila principal (thread-safe)."""
            if self._stopper.is_set():
                return
            try:
                self._queue.put_nowait((tab_id, kind, *args))
            except BlockingError:
                pass

    """Converte mídia usando ffmpeg (ou soundfile para ALAC se falhar)."""
    finished = QtCore.Signal(bool, str)

    def __init__(self, input_path, output_path, fmt, tab_id, manager,
                 video_output=True, cancel_event=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.input_path = Path(input_path)
        self.output_path = Path(output_path)
        self.fmt = fmt

        self._output_dir = Path(str(output_path).rsplit("/", 1)[0])
    def run(self):
        if self.cancel.is_set():
            self.manager.enqueue(self.tab_id, "finish", False, "Tarefa cancelada pelo usuário.")
            return
        try:
            import subprocess
        except ImportError:
            self.manager.enqueue(self.tab_id, "finish", False, "subprocess não disponível.")
            return
        # garante pasta de destino
        try:
            if not self._output_dir.exists():
                self._output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as e:
            self.manager.enqueue(self.tab_id, "finish", False, f"Pasta de saída inacessível: {e}")
            return
        try:
            cmd = self._build_cmd()
            self._proc = subprocess.Popen(
                cmd, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
            try:
                last_pct = 0
                while not self._proc.poll() and not self.cancel.is_set():
                    line = self._proc.stderr.readline()
                    if not line:
                        break
                    self._parse_line(line, last_pct, self)
                    last_pct = _new_pct
                stdout, stderr = self._proc.communicate()
                err = "".join(self._proc.stderr.buffer.read() if hasattr(self._proc, "stderr") and not hasattr(self._proc, "read") else b"")
                # Tentativa melhor
                try:
                    err = self._proc.stderr.read().decode(errors="replace")
                except Exception:
                    err = ""
                if self._proc.returncode != 0:
                    raise RuntimeError(err)
                self.success = True
                rel = ""
                if self.output_path.is_relative_to(Path.cwd()):
                    rel = str(self.output_path.relative_to(Path.cwd()))
                else:
                    rel = str(self.output_path)
                self.msg = f"OK — {rel}"
            except RuntimeError as e:
                self.msg = str(e)
            except Exception as e:
                self.msg = str(e)
            finally:
                self.manager.enqueue(self.tab_id, "finish", self.success, self.msg if self.msg else "Conversão concluída.")
        except Exception as e:
            self.manager.enqueue(self.tab_id, "finish", False, str(e))
    def _build_cmd(self):
        """Monta comando ffmpeg conforme formato."""
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "quiet", "-y", "-i", str(self.input_path)]
        if self.video_output:
            info = MEDIA_FMTS_VIDEO.get(self.fmt)
            if not info:
                return []
            cmd += ["-c:v", info["vcodec"]]
            if info.get("vopts"):
                cmd += info["vopts"].split()
            cmd += ["-c:a", info["acodec"]]
            if info.get("abits"):
                cmd += [info["abits"]]
            cmd += ["-f", info["container"], str(self.output_path)]
            return cmd
        # áudio
        audio = MEDIA_FMTS_AUDIO.get(self.fmt)
        if not audio:
            return []
        codec = audio["codec"]
        extra = []
        if codec != "alac":
            extra.append("-c:a", codec)
        if audio.get("bits"):
            extra.append(audio["bits"])
        if audio.get("opt"):
            extra.extend(["-q:a", audio["opt"][2:] if len(audio["opt"]) > 2 else "5"])
        cmd += extra + ["-y", str(self.output_path)]
        return cmd
    def _parse_line(self, line, last_pct, worker):
        """Analisa uma linha do stderr do ffmpeg e devolve novo percentual."""
        prog = PROG_RE.search(line)
        pct = 0
        if prog:
            pct = int(prog.group(1))
        # atualiza total/restante
        if pct < 100:
            rm = REM_RE.search(line)
            if rm:
                try:
                    num = float(rm.group(1))
                    den = float(rm.group(2))
                    if den > 0:
                        pct = min(100, round((den - num) / den * 100))
                except ValueError:
                    pass
        # status
        st = ""
        tm = TIME_RE.search(line)
        if tm:
            s = int(tm.group(2)) * 60 + int(tm.group(3))
            m = int(tm.group(1)) * 60 + s
            st = f"Restam {m//60:d}:{m%60:02d}"
        fm = FRAMES_RE.search(line)
        if fm:
            st = f"Frames: {fm.group(1)} | {st}"
        if st:
            worker.manager.enqueue(worker.tab_id, "status", st)
        if pct != last_pct:
            worker.manager.enqueue(worker.tab_id, "progress", pct)
            last_pct = pct

class QualityPreviewWorker(QRunnable):
    """Moce qualidades disponíveis sem baixar o vídeo."""
    qualities_ready = QtCore.Signal(int, str, list)  # tab_id, rotulo escolhido, lista infos
    finished = QtCore.Signal(bool, str)

    def __init__(self, url, tab_id, manager):
        super().__init__()
        self.url = url
        self.tab_id = tab_id
        self.manager = manager
        self._ydl = None

    def run(self):
        try:
            import yt_dlp
        except ImportError:
            self.finished.emit(False, "yt-dlp não instalado. Instale com: pip install yt-dlp")
            return
        ydl_opts = {
            "quiet": True,
            "no_warnings": True,
            "skip_download": True,
            "update_in_cache": False,
            "ignoreerrors": True,
            "continuedlistas": [],
        }
        ydl = yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(ydl_opts)
        try:
            info = ydl.extract_info(self.url, process=True)
        except Exception as e:
            self.finished.emit(False, f"Erro ao buscar informações: {e}")
            return
        if info is None or not info.get("formats"):
            self.finished.emit(False, "Nenhuma resolução disponível.")
            return
        formats = info["formats"]
        allowed_map = ALLOWED_QUALITIES
        sorted_formats = sorted(formats, key=lambda f: f.get("height", 0))
        chosen_label = None
        chosen_stream = None
        for label, max_h in allowed_map:
            candidates = [f for f in sorted_formats if f.get("height") <= max_h]
            exact = [f for f in candidates if (f.get("resolution") or "") == label or label in (f.get("string") or "")]
            if exact:
                chosen_stream = max(exact, key=lambda f: f.get("average_bitrate", 0) or f.get("width", 0))
                chosen_label = chosen_stream.get("resolution")
                break
            else:
                chosen_stream = max(candidates, key=lambda f: f.get("average_bitrate", 0) or f.get("width", 0))
                chosen_label = chosen_stream.get("resolution")
        if chosen_label is None:
            best = max(sorted_formats, key=lambda f: f.get("average_bitrate", 0) or f.get("width", 0))
            chosen_label = best.get("resolution")
            chosen_stream = best

        infos = []
        for f in sorted(sorted_formats, key=lambda f: f.get("height", 0)):
            h = f.get("height", 0)
            label = to_resolution_label(h)
            sz = f.get("average_size_bytes", 0) or 0
            bt = f.get("average_bitrate", 0) or 0
            infos.append({
                "label": label,
                "size": fmt_size(sz),
                "bitrate": fmt_bitrate(bt),
                "meta": (label, fmt_size(sz), fmt_bitrate(bt)),
            })

        self.qualities_ready.emit(self.tab_id, chosen_label if chosen_label else "(sem rótulo)", infos)
        self.finished.emit(True, f"Pronto. Escolha {chosen_label or '(qualidade automática)'} acima.")
